title: Credit Grade and Review Months: C&I Anniversary Review Table
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: anniversary security review: review months by recorded grade.

The review months follow the grade recorded on the contract's posted security deposit, which is the commercial credit grade used when the contract was executed and not the grade on the customer profile today: a deposit recording grade A gives 0 review months, a deposit recording grade B gives 1, and a deposit recording grade C or not rated, or no posted deposit, gives 2.

The grade is the credit grade basis shown on the contract's security deposit receipt; where the contract carries more than one receipt, the most recently posted receipt is read.

| Grade recorded on the contract's posted security deposit | Review months |
|---|---|
| A | 0 |
| B | 1 |
| C | 2 |
| not rated | 2 |
| no posted deposit on the contract | 2 |

## Points of judgement

- The profile shows grade B today, while the receipt records grade A: 0 review months, the recorded grade governing.
- The profile shows grade A today, while the receipt records not rated: 2 review months.
- A contract with no security deposit receipt: 2 review months.
